clue.text: Excellent binge in New York he had with groom — here's something to help search

parts.note: fine means excellent, of high quality
toot is American slang for a drinking spree, hence the New York tag
he'd, the contraction of he had, without its apostrophe
to groom hair is to comb it

explanation.surface: A New York reveller who has been on a bender with a bridegroom is offered something to help search.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In New York' flags an American slang sense: there a toot is a drinking spree. 'He had' is used in its contracted form, apostrophe dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine-toothed comb is the idiom for a very thorough examination, and the literal comb picks out tiny things.

clue.text: Doctor, one from France, seen around railway test

indicators.note: something seen around another thing encloses it, so the letters wrap round what follows

parts.note: standard abbreviation for doctor
un is French for one
RY is the abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: A doctor and a Frenchman are spotted near a railway carrying out a test.
explanation.walkthrough: The railway letters do not wrap the doctor and the Frenchman whole: they sit just after the first letter of the joined pair.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry run is a rehearsal or trial carried out before the real thing, so it is a test.

clue.text: Systematic check-up securing most of the oxygen

indicators.note: most of a word means all but its last letter is used
to secure something is to hold it fast, so one piece holds the others inside it

parts.note: a medical is a health check-up
the word the without its final letter
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A thorough health check-up that includes an oxygen measurement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Most of the oxygen' reads as a quantity of gas, but 'most of' trims only the little word 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: Methodical describes working in an orderly, planned way, the same as systematic.

clue.text: Perhaps ruby breast finally seen amongst the robins flying

indicators.note: to be amongst others is to sit inside the group, so one letter goes inside
birds flying scatter about, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word it follows

parts.note: the last letter of breast

explanation.surface: A robin's red breast glimpsed among a flock in flight, likened to a ruby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps ruby' wants to describe the robin's red breast, but it is the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruby is the traditional gem for July births, so it is one example of a birthstone.

clue.text: Panic following part of race

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references
a lap is one circuit of a race

explanation.surface: A runner panics after completing a section of the race.
explanation.definitionFit: A flap is informal for a state of agitated alarm, which is a panic.

clue.text: Affected millions restricted by upper limit

indicators.note: being restricted by something means being held within it

parts.note: a cap is a ceiling on an amount
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: Millions of people affected by a cap on spending.
explanation.definitionFit: Camp describes exaggerated, theatrical behaviour, which is affected or mannered.

clue.text: Death — with 50% of fish, it's a fruit stone

parts.note: death is the end of life

indicators.note: fifty per cent is half, and half of a two-letter word is its first letter

parts.note: half of the little word of
the carp is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Death comes to a fish via a hard fruit stone, half of which is fish.
explanation.walkthrough: '50% of fish' looks like half a fish, but the half is taken from the word 'of' itself, leaving the whole fish to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: The endocarp is the innermost layer of a fruit's wall, which in a plum or cherry hardens into the stone.

clue.text: Disruption of regatta foreseen in historic African zone

indicators.note: a disruption throws things out of their usual order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Somebody predicted that a boating regatta would be disrupted somewhere in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The Orange Free State was a nineteenth-century Boer republic, later a province of South Africa.

clue.text: Leader of Italy? Legendary King's backing one Mediterranean resident

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the word is read from the end
the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of Italy
King Lear of legend, with the possessive s
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A legendary king is supporting the man who leads Italy, a Mediterranean figure.
explanation.walkthrough: Lear is the legendary British king of Shakespeare's play.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel lies on the eastern Mediterranean coast, so an Israeli lives in the Mediterranean region.

clue.text: Student's attention engaged by historic railway

indicators.note: being engaged by something means being held within it, like gears

parts.note: the London and North Eastern Railway, a pre-nationalisation British company
to give an ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: A student's interest held by a famous old railway line.
explanation.walkthrough: The LNER ran Britain's east-coast main line from 1923 to 1948. The 's in Student's is a contraction of 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner is someone studying, so the word is a synonym for student.

clue.text: Location of fire initially suppressed with soil

indicators.note: suppressing the start of a word means its opening letter is dropped

parts.note: a hearth is the floor of a fireplace

explanation.surface: A fire is put out at its source by smothering it with soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fire initially' wants to give F, but 'initially suppressed' acts on the whole fireplace word.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is the loose ground material that plants grow in, which is soil.

clue.text: Plutonium included in revised plan too? Extra funding required

indicators.note: something included in another sits inside it
a revised version has been reworked, so these letters are reordered

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
Pu is the chemical symbol for plutonium

explanation.surface: A nuclear project's revised plan, plutonium and all, needs extra money.
explanation.definitionFit: A top-up loan is an additional sum borrowed on top of an existing loan, hence extra funding.

clue.text: Had too much, swallowing booze I abandoned

indicators.note: something swallowing another takes it inside

parts.note: OD is short for overdose, too much of a drug

indicators.note: abandoning the letter I means it is dropped from the word

parts.note: wine is a kind of booze

explanation.surface: Someone drank too much, gulping down alcohol, and gave up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Had too much' reads as one phrase about overindulging, but 'Had' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To have something is to possess it, and owned is the past tense of possess in that sense.

clue.text: USA talent re-engineered Gulf region?

indicators.note: something re-engineered is rebuilt to a new design, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: American expertise rebuilding things in the Persian Gulf.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks a definition by example: Oman is a sultanate on the Gulf.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultanate is a territory ruled by a sultan, and several such states sit around the Arabian Gulf.

clue.text: Jurisprudence, note, upheld wrong feature of court in court activity

parts.note: jurisprudence is the study of law
N is the abbreviation for note

indicators.note: in a down clue, holding something up means reading it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a sin is a moral wrong
a net stretches across the middle of a tennis court

explanation.surface: A legal note was upheld about wrongdoing in a court of law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jurisprudence' and 'court' set up a law-court scene, but the court is a sports court.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawn tennis is the formal name of the game played on a court, so it is an activity there.

clue.text: Articles about border and the area around a Biblical region

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the two letters go either side

parts.note: two indefinite articles, a and a
a rim is an edge or border

indicators.note: around means enclosing, so the letters wrap round a single one

parts.note: the as written plus A for area
taken as written

explanation.surface: Articles about a frontier and the surrounding district in a Bible land.
explanation.walkthrough: Joseph of Arimathaea gave his tomb for the burial of Jesus.
explanation.definitionFit: Arimathaea is the place in Judea named in the Gospels as Joseph's home, so it is a Biblical location.

clue.text: Snuff excessively probed by British account

indicators.note: a probe pushes inside, so the probing letters go inside the other word

parts.note: too means excessively
B is the abbreviation for British
acc is an abbreviation for account

explanation.surface: A British financial account under intense scrutiny for being snuffed out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snuff' looks like a verb for putting out, but it is the powdered tobacco sniffed up the nose.
explanation.definitionFit: Snuff is powdered tobacco for inhaling, so the answer is the general substance it is a form of.

clue.text: Deprived, before a volume is secured by qualified teacher

indicators.note: being secured by something means being held fast inside it

parts.note: a BEd, Bachelor of Education, is a teaching degree
ere is a poetic word for before
taken as written
V is the abbreviation for volume

explanation.surface: A deprived pupil awaits a book that a qualified teacher has locked away.
explanation.definitionFit: Bereaved means having lost someone to death, a sense of being deprived of a loved one.

clue.text: Wife drawn to man's person and tone of voice

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for wife
his means belonging to a man
per is the grammatical abbreviation for person

explanation.surface: A wife is attracted by a man's physique and his voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A whisper is a hushed, breathy way of speaking, one particular tone of voice.

clue.text: Corrupt company mostly to regret ignoring a registration

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the final letter is cut

parts.note: Enron was the US energy company that collapsed in a 2001 fraud scandal

indicators.note: ignoring the letter a means it is left out of the word

parts.note: to lament is to regret or mourn

explanation.surface: A crooked firm comes to regret skipping a registration.
explanation.definitionFit: Enrolment is the act of signing up on a list or course, which is a registration.

clue.text: Daughters tucking into beer becoming confused

indicators.note: tucking into something means getting inside it

parts.note: ale is a kind of beer
D is the abbreviation for daughter, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: Daughters getting stuck into the beer and growing muddled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tucking into' suggests eating or drinking heartily; here it just puts the letters inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Addle is used adjectivally, as in addle-brained, meaning muddled or confused.

clue.text: University event interrupting academic, an intimidating figure

indicators.note: something interrupting another breaks into the middle of it

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer
rag week is a British student charity fundraising event

explanation.surface: A rowdy student event disturbs a stern lecturer.
explanation.walkthrough: A don is a lecturer at Oxford or Cambridge; a rag is a student charity stunt.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragon is informally a fierce, formidable person, someone intimidating.

clue.text: Boxer embraced by man, popular Russian singer

indicators.note: something embraced by another is held inside its arms

parts.note: a chap is a man
Muhammad Ali, the heavyweight boxer
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A boxer is hugged by a man who is a well-loved Russian singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Feodor Chaliapin was a celebrated Russian operatic bass of the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Component of lens is supporting infrared

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece supporting another sits below it

parts.note: IR is the abbreviation for infrared
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lens part sits under an infrared filter.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris diaphragm is the adjustable aperture ring built into a camera lens.

clue.text: Farm animals put in green spaces at first

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of each following word

parts.note: the first letters of these four words

explanation.surface: Livestock are turned out to graze in green fields.
explanation.definitionFit: Pigs are raised as livestock on farms, so they are farm animals.

clue.text: Pick up source of tremendous courage

parts.note: to pick up a sound is to hear it

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, its first letter

parts.note: the first letter of tremendous

explanation.surface: Collect the origin of tremendous bravery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pick up' wants to mean lift or collect; here it means catch by ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Heart is used for courage, as in 'take heart' or 'lose heart'.

clue.text: Formally qualified in Government appointment

parts.note: meet is a formal or archaic word for suitable or fitting
taken as written
G is the abbreviation for government

explanation.surface: A formally qualified candidate gets a government appointment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appointment' looks like a post given to someone, but it is an arranged meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: An appointment is an arrangement to see someone at a set time, which is a meeting.

clue.text: One guy receiving honour after backing winter transport

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: receiving something means taking it inside

parts.note: cat is slang for a man, a guy

indicators.note: after backing means once turned round to run the other way

parts.note: the OBE, Officer of the Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: A man getting a royal honour after supporting a winter travel scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: An iceboat is a sail-powered craft on runners that skims over frozen lakes, a form of winter transport.
